name: io.github.dtvillafana/outlook-email-mcp
description: Local stdio MCP server for Claude Desktop that reads Outlook emails and message bodies, parses attachments (PDF/OCR/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/images/archives/MSG), and sends local files as Outlook attachments — via Microsoft Graph.

environment_variables.name: M365_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Microsoft Entra application (client) ID used for device-code login.

environment_variables.name: M365_TENANT_ID
environment_variables.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Use common for multi-tenant or personal Microsoft accounts.

environment_variables.name: M365_AUTO_OPEN_BROWSER
environment_variables.description: Whether begin_auth should attempt to open the Microsoft login page automatically.

environment_variables.name: M365_SEND_MAX_BYTES
environment_variables.description: Optional total attachment-size budget (bytes) for send_outlook_email. Default 3145728 (3 MB); must stay under Graph's ~4 MB request limit.

environment_variables.name: M365_SEND_ALLOWED_DIRS
environment_variables.description: Optional OS-path-separated allowlist of directories send_outlook_email may read attachment files from. Empty (default) allows any readable path.
